about: Canon every product shares: Hawkes Biomedical, its people and its rules. Studio imports this at startup (memory.ts importSeed); keyed, so editing here updates the entries unless J edited them in the Memory tab.

entries.title: Hawkes Biomedical is a fictional pharma megacorp over every product
entries.body: Each game is presented publicly as one of the company's medical products; the game is the thing behind that front. hawkesbiomedical.com lists the product line. Its footer says the company is a work of fiction.

entries.title: Pierce Hawkes is Chairman, at Hawkes Tower, 58th floor
entries.body: HQ: Hawkes Tower (1000 Madison Avenue, New York), the 58th floor boardroom is the Apex Peak. Capital and investor relations desk in Zurich. Pierce sells dominance and category ownership.

entries.title: The board is Director Hale, Voss and Lang, with no first names
entries.body: Never invent first names. Hale (she) watches the quarter and the valuation; Voss (he) keeps the charter and calls B3's people patients; Lang keeps the date Zurich wants. The other chairs are silent and unnamed.

entries.title: The public line: "We do not pitch a cure. We own the category."
entries.body: Category ownership, never a cure. Pierce's own line: "There's always room for grace." and "Compliance does not set the ceiling. I do."

entries.title: The secret is basement B3: the vat and the creature
entries.body: B3 (Sector 4 / B-102) is the restricted lab under the tower: containment, decon, the acid vat, an unnamed creature. Pierce's transformation is told in PH Origins. Never put B3, the vat, the creature or gameplay on the corporate site.

entries.title: Products are never called games on the corporate site
entries.body: Public framings: PH Origins = pH balance; Sick Of It = single-use fever shots; Dose Of Destruction = cytotoxic dose; Yooba Land = hyporexia support; I Can Be = AI-assisted full-body assessment; The Place Department = HIPAA-compliant document storage; Imagine Live TV = live medical education.

entries.title: Every IP character can fight in Dose Of Destruction
entries.body: AllTheCharacters/<Folder>/ holds each character (33 so far); their stats, names and roles live in doseofdestructionwebsite/content/fighters.json. A new character that fights gets a folder there.
